ModMetaData.name: Hacking Expansion: Netrun
ModMetaData.author: Raul Moreau
ModMetaData.description:
A cyberpunk layer for Ushanka's Hacking Expansion. Every intrusion leaves a digital trace, and the net always answers.
• Network terminal: the comms console becomes a network console (also in the cyberpod) with a navigation screen: Core, Club, Board, Archive, Server room, Studio, Gateway, and the in-game Cyberpedia. • Digital Heat: five levels from Shadow to Red Zone, network attacks and a hidden mercenary faction that follows your trace. • Cyberspace: one living map per game, about 45 hubs in districts, corporations and rival runner crews, protected corporate hubs, turn-based dives with programs, daemons, code gates and Black ICE. A free training dive for newcomers. • Fixers and contracts: calls, trace scrubbing, a shop, reputation, eight kinds of contracts. • Networked AIs: 13 personalities on an AI server, in a cyberpod coprocessor or in a colonist's AI socket, with services, hunger, trust, quests and 75 events. • Braindance: goggles record strong moments, edit them into chips, mind the addiction. • Hub defense, Netsick, DLC content (Royalty, Ideology, Biotech, Odyssey), four scenarios and a late-game ending.
Requires Hacking Expansion, Harmony and Vanilla Expanded Framework. RimWorld 1.6 and 1.7. English and Russian. MIT License.
Киберпанк-дополнение к Hacking Expansion: сетевой терминал, цифровой след, живая карта киберпространства и нырки, фиксеры и контракты, корпорации, сетевые ИИ, брейнданс и поздний финал. Перевод на русский язык включён.
